hints.content: There are many ways to find the vertex. We will do it by using the fact that the $t$-coordinate of the vertex is exactly between the two zeros.

In conclusion,

$\begin{align}
\text{smaller }t&=2
\\\\
\text{larger }t&=15
\end{align}$

The vertex of the parabola is at

$\left(\dfrac{17}{2},\dfrac{169}{4}\right)$

question.content:
$f(t)=-(t-2)(t-15)$

**1) What are the zeros of the function?**  
*Write the smaller $t$ first, and the larger $t$ second.*

$\text{smaller }t=$ [[☃ input-number 1]]

$\text{larger }t=$ [[☃ input-number 2]]

**2) What is the vertex of the parabola?**

$($[[☃ input-number 3]]$,$[[☃ input-number 4]]$)$
